notes.title: Patch 0.7.8(B) Released
notes.content:
Patch 0.7.8(B) Released

* Quest system testing implemented (default bind = Q) ; DragonSlayer quest resetting for testing on a weekly basis

* Stone material changes to Everhaven

* Various frame rate updates to Everhaven & Labyrinth 

Special Note: New tournament coming to Labyrinth mode soon! Cash prize details to be announced.

notes.title: Adonis is coming to Early Access on November 13th!
notes.content:
OCT 13. PATCH NOTES: 
* Main menu fixes
* Lighting fixes
* Additional NPC combat implemented

For those of you who haven't heard of Adonis, prepare your crew! Adonis is a stylized, whimsical open world MMO that focuses on both large scale combat and smaller scale PvP combat! Get ready for an intense adventure in the open world of Candala!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31777769/73a36e5c3d06916dc5931090e923b04af46f483b.gif[/img]

Features:

* Massive, functional & stylized (medieval & post-medieval) environments

* Combat with up to 1,500 other players online in a single server! Other game modes include 6v6, FFA and Team DM.

* Defeat various enemies (both online players and AI enemies)

* NOTE TO BETA TESTERS: We are currently working on hit registration programming and fixes, and if you test the game before 9/19/2020, you will notice hitbox registration issues and other major issues. 

Have a look at our trailers and circle November 13th on your calendars! Add Adonis to your Steam wishlist today! 

We would also like to take this time to acknowledge Eric Stevens (former Los Angeles Rams player and ex-classmate of our CEO) and his family for their efforts to combate ALS! Head over to StevensNation.com if you have a few extra minutes, and learn about their amazing story to #axeALS and bring relief to countless people around the world. Together, we can create a better future for ALS patients and their families!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31777769/3ee2e56095d3efaad8193045b02237d1200da744.jpg[/img]

Thank you for your time,

Michael L. Fiorentino Gutierrez
CEO, Lorenzo Entertainment
Mike@LorenzoEnt.com
www.LorenzoEnt.com
